D53-1.txt#5: That's what the police are for, isn't it?!\nIf that fails, the Earth turns curry-colored tomorrow!!

D54-0.txt#1: Lacing curry with poison for insurance money is unforgivable!
D54-0.txt#10: Heh heh!\nYou've gone too far - we can't back down now.\nAkasaka, let's go...!!
D54-0.txt#11: Good grief... I suppose it can't be helped.\n...I'll go at you for real...!
D54-0.txt#2: How rude! Our goals are far more noble!!
D54-0.txt#3: We're merely spreading the wonders of curry worldwide\nand making maid uniforms the required dress\nfor anyone who eats it.
D54-0.txt#4: The world will be united by curry, and wars will end!\nHumanity will achieve lasting peace!!
D54-0.txt#5: And through worldwide maid education,\nwe'll restore cuteness, modesty, and grace!
D54-0.txt#6: ...I can't tell if this is a vast conspiracy or just nonsense...
D54-0.txt#7: Ah, anyway, anyway!\nThe police are confiscating that suspicious fur seal.
D54-0.txt#8: We won't allow it!!\nYou fiend, trying to stop the maid world!!
D54-0.txt#9: World peace is God's will!!\nAs His instruments, I'll bury you all!!
D54-1.txt#0: Total subjugation!!\nAnyone still dare defy the teachers?! No one?!
D54-1.txt#2: ...Then, for this club event, let's call it\nour surprise victory and be done with it.
D54-1.txt#3: I never thought we'd bring peace to Earth like this.
D54-1.txt#4: Ms. Chie, we've only just laid our hands on that door.
D54-1.txt#5: Come, let us lead!\nThe lost lambs into a world of curry and maids!!!
D55-0.txt#0: W-Who are you people?!\nThis is a school!!
D55-0.txt#1: Don't shout, please.\nI'm a parent, thank you very much!
D55-0.txt#2: ...You don't look the part at all. My apologies...
D55-0.txt#3: Ah, I'm sorry.\nYou're Mrs. Sonozaki, aren't you? Thank you for everything.
D55-0.txt#4: So, you see!\nI heard my daughters' club had an interesting prize.\nSo I came to join in!
D55-0.txt#5: That's a problem!\nThat club is causing such a ruckus,\nI was just going around telling them to stop!
D55-0.txt#6: Oh, come now.\nYou're after the matchmaking fur seal too, aren't you?\nKasai, are you ready?!
D55-0.txt#7: I don't know what you mean, but it's a misunderstanding!\nAh, Dr. Irie!! Give me a hand!!
D55-1.txt#0: ...Boss... are the teachers really all right with this...?
D55-1.txt#1: They say you can't catch a cold with a full belly.\nCome on, let's chase down the club members!!\nBeat them all and take the prize!!
